case_family.name: PRE 2025 Table II reduced spherical-surface static droplet

author_raw_data_workbook.content_note: The workbook contains author-provided curve data for Fig.11(a,b), Fig.12(a,b), Fig.16(a), Fig.17(a), Fig.18(a), Fig.19(a), and Fig.21(a). It is supplementary figure data, not the Table II spherical-static error table.
author_raw_data_workbook.table_II_note: For the reduced spherical-static setup, continue using table_II_sphere_errors.csv and table_II_sphere_targets.csv.

target_geometry_note.formula: The target table_II_sphere_targets.csv is computed by conserving the initial spherical droplet volume outside a solid sphere and using Hmax = liquid_sphere_radius + center_distance; H1_minus_H2 = Hmax - solid_sphere_radius.
target_geometry_note.table_I_crosscheck: This formula matches the article Table I expected Hmax values for 50-150 deg to roundoff-level table precision, but gives 145.38 lu at 30 deg versus the extracted Table I value 142.85 lu. Treat low-angle exactness as pending PDF/equation audit.
target_geometry_note.claim_limit: These targets are suitable for TCLB analogue setup and postprocessing. They are not proof of formula equivalence between PRE 2025 and TCLB.

tclb_model_note.reason: q27 phase-field plus geometric wetting plus staircase improvement exposes ActualNormal and special-boundary counters for a curved solid sphere.
tclb_model_note.known_limitation: Current TCLB model is not the PRE 2025 D3Q19/D3Q19 conservative AC MRT model. Any run is an independent TCLB analogue unless the PRE wall formula is implemented directly.

raw_output_policy: Keep raw VTI/PVTI remote-only unless explicitly requested.
